text:
Yes, a possible loss has been detected, but it is not yet corroborated.

The current evidence (version 2, as of 2026-11-12) shows a tree-cover loss candidate of 13.5 ha (about 3.9% of the 345.6 ha property) in 2025. It is flagged as pending corroboration because 2025 is the latest year in the series, so a later year is needed to confirm it. The JRC 2020 forest map agrees with the location at 0.98, and the area is in a native forest context.

The earlier version (through 2024) found no loss of 0.5 ha or more between 2021 and 2024. It is superseded, but it is consistent with the loss appearing only in 2025.

The evidence does not establish:
- whether the change is persistent
- whether it is deforestation or land-use change (Hansen counts any stand replacement, including harvest)
- the cause
- whether it was legal or authorized
- any compliance finding
